threads.title: Kafka migration for event pipeline
threads.arc: Monday: Maya picks up ticket EV-482 to move the order-events topic from the old RabbitMQ bridge. Tuesday: she hits a serialization issue with the Avro schema and posts in #integrations; Priya suggests reusing the existing schema registry subject. Wednesday: she writes a migration script and runs it against staging, but the consumer lag spikes. Thursday: she fixes the consumer group offset reset and coordinates with Tom to deploy the new bridge. Friday: PR #1187 is approved and merged; she updates the runbook and closes EV-482.

threads.title: Consumer group naming decision
threads.arc: Monday: Maya proposes naming consumer groups by service and environment (e.g. `order-sync-prod`). Tuesday: Marcus pushes back, wanting a version suffix. Wednesday: she creates a short comparison doc and polls the team in Slack. Thursday: the team votes 4-2 for `order-sync-prod-v2` style. Friday: she updates the migration script and the runbook to use the new convention.

threads.title: Invoice question from Jules at Northwind Analytics
threads.arc: Tuesday: Jules emails Maya asking why invoice #INV-22904 is missing from the exported dataset. Wednesday: Maya checks the pipeline logs and finds the event was dropped due to a malformed timestamp. Thursday: she sends Jules a corrected CSV and explains the fix. Friday: Jules confirms the invoice now appears and asks for a small schema change; Maya adds it to the backlog.

threads.title: Weekend trip to Fredericksburg
threads.arc: Monday: Lena texts Maya about booking a cabin for the weekend. Tuesday: Maya checks Airbnb and sends Lena two options. Wednesday: they book the cabin (reservation #HB-88231) and split the cost. Thursday: Maya texts Grandma Ruth to ask if she wants to join for Saturday wine tasting. Friday: Grandma says yes, and Maya adds a stop at the wildflower farm to the itinerary.

threads.title: Side project: recipe scraper
threads.arc: Maya tinkers with a small Python script to scrape recipes from a cooking site. Monday: she refactors the parser to use BeautifulSoup. Wednesday: she gets blocked by a Cloudflare challenge and tries using Playwright. Friday: she gets it working for a few test URLs and commits it to a private GitHub repo.
